# Dreamy Vacations

> Dreamy Vacations is a family and group accommodation property located in Chikkathur Village near Kushalnagar, Coorg, Karnataka, India.

Dreamy Vacations provides accommodation for couples, families and groups visiting Coorg (Kodagu), with an outdoor swimming pool, rain dance area, indoor tabletop games, evening campfire setups, complimentary Wi-Fi, and on-site parking. Positioned in eastern Coorg near Kushalnagar, the property gives guests convenient access to Bylakuppe's Tibetan settlements, Namdroling Monastery (Golden Temple), Kaveri Nisargadhama, Dubare Elephant Camp, Harangi Dam, and Chiklihole Reservoir, while supporting day trips westward toward Madikeri's waterfalls and viewpoints.
